questiontext.text: Which of the following is the most accurate definition of Home Economics?

generalfeedback.text: Home Economics integrates multiple sciences and arts to manage family resources and enhance individual and community well-being.

answer.text: The study of wild animals living in national parks

feedback.text: Incorrect. Home Economics integrates multiple sciences and arts to manage family resources and enhance individual and community well-being.

answer.text: The study of ancient stone tools used in traditional hunting

questiontext.text: Which of the following are core branches of Home Economics? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Food & Nutrition, Clothing & Textiles, and Home Management are core branches. Petroleum geology is an earth science.

questiontext.text: Which of the following professional careers can be pursued through specialized training in Home Economics? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Dietetics, fashion design, and professional catering are direct Home Economics career pathways.

questiontext.text: Match each branch of Home Economics with its primary area of focus:

generalfeedback.text: Food & Nutrition is diet/cooking; Clothing & Textiles is fibers/sewing; Home Management is resources/budgeting; Child Development is pediatric growth.

generalfeedback.text: Dietitians work in hospitals; Fashion designers in apparel studios; Chefs in culinary hotels; Interior decorators in home styling.
